About us

A Kakamega company, run by people who cook with what they sell.

Elite Pongamia Bioenergy Project Ltd is a Kenyan renewable energy company with its head office in Kakamega. We chair the Kakamega County Renewable Energy Network, host the Kakamega e-Cooking Hub, and have helped shape county energy planning and Kenya’s clean cooking strategy.

10years at it
6solutions
1county network chaired
Who runs it. A Board of Directors (Chairperson, Secretary, Treasurer, Board Member) oversees the company. Chief Executive Officer Mr. Danson Ligare leads the Finance and Administration Manager and the Technical Manager. The Technical Manager oversees the Project Managers for Kakuma and for External Programmes, who supervise field support staff.
Licensed work

Solar work you can check.

Fitting solar on a roof or into a building is regulated work. In Kenya the Energy & Petroleum Regulatory Authority, EPRA, licenses the technicians allowed to do it. Our solar technician’s licence is shown here, so you can see it for yourself.

  1. InstallFit solar PV systems safely, the right way round.
  2. Test & inspectCheck that everything works and is wired correctly.
  3. CommissionSwitch the system on and hand it over, including grid-connected and hybrid systems.

Licence no. EPRA/SPVT/001851/Class T3/Issued 11-06-2026/Expires 10-06-2027

Good habit with any installer: ask to see their licence before work starts.
